Four Google tools were added by the project owner on 2026-11-04 beyond the Adspirer extract: get_keyword_performance, get_segment_performance, remove_negative_keywords_from_list, detach_negative_keyword_list_from_campaign. On 2026-11-05 the owner added list_accounts (workspace-level), because no inventoried tool returned the account_id the other tools require.

On 2026-11-10 the owner approved 54 tools for Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager, including 11 combined tools and get_property_links (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-10-gsc-ga4-gtm-design.md). A combined tool is filed under the platform of the account its account_id names.

On 2026-11-11 the owner added link_existing_assets (Google Ads): the add tools always create a new asset, so an asset already in the library (such as an existing phone number) could not be attached to another campaign.
